title: Labcorp Holdings Inc. Q1 2026 Form 10-Q
excerpt: For Q1 2026 Labcorp reported USD 3.538 billion revenue, USD 380.8 million operating income, USD 981.1 million cash, and USD 6.33 billion total debt.
summary: The SEC filing confirms the LH/XNYS common-stock identity, segment economics, cash flow, liquidity, debt, acquisition and payer risks, and the latest reported inputs used in the bounded valuation.
